title: Method overview v55 - two-band causal pipeline

composition.top: model provenance: demonstrations -> route learning -> physical adaptation -> trained generator
composition.bottom: deployment spine: observation -> generator -> task-aligned free coordinates -> analytic decoder -> path
composition.shared_anchor: the adapted generator is the deployed generator; the shared boundary-aligned path space is indicated by the spline icon in Stage 1 and the orange deployment decoder

visual_rules: no explicit backpropagation loop in the overview
no isolated contribution towers or large feedback loop
training-only full terrain is a local annotation for rollover stability
deployment path is the strongest visual line
input and output thumbnails use a muted repository terrain map rather than generic scenery
no long connector crosses the training and deployment bands
full terrain is visibly excluded from deployment
ASCII-only rendered labels for conversion compatibility
minimum body text remains readable in a full-width IEEE figure
training-only full terrain is integrated locally under the rollover objective
major rows use rules and whitespace rather than card-like outer containers
explicit arrowhead polygons replace SVG markers for renderer robustness
terrain normals are visually muted so the generated path remains dominant
method-name-independent labels avoid premature naming lock-in
deployment condition is stated once below the masked observation
redundant microcopy is removed after 800-pixel readability review
labels use concrete planning semantics instead of shorthand or implementation jargon
long training labels wrap inside their nodes
full terrain is a distinct training-only input to rollover supervision
both training stages retain the same deployment-visible condition
start and goal are visibly inside the masked admissible region
top training band contains only the causal training stages
input and output thumbnails depict the same start-goal task
the output path is overlaid on the same masked observation rather than complete terrain
raster terrain thumbnails are embedded as data URIs in the delivery SVG
standard subfigure headings replace non-causal contribution numbering
training header and shared-model note occupy separate aligned positions
physical objective labels match the Method nomenclature
explicit arrowheads visualize fixed start and goal headings
representation label states fixed endpoint poses rather than generic boundary
heading arrows are concentrated in the representation module to avoid stray input symbols
full terrain is labeled training-only beside the rollover objective
notes: Two-band overview with a minimal local full-terrain annotation and a shared boundary-aligned path-space icon.
